## Page 5

4Operating Revenue
3Q/2025
▪Operating revenue increased +2.2% YoY and +8.0% QoQ, driven by both 
revenue from sales and revenue from rental.
▪Despite the slowdown economic conditions, total sales continued to grow 
YoY and QoQ, mainly from the retail store and online channels.
▪The %GPM from sales improved YoY due to the effective discount 
management and the higher proportion from retail stores. While the 
%GPM from sales slightly declined QoQ due to a lower proportion of sales 
from retail stores.
▪Rental and services revenue increased YoY and QoQ, driven by the new 
rental areas added at Little Walk Rattanathibet  and Little Walk 
Ramkhamhaeng as well as the expansion of rental space at the Chiang Mai 
branch after renovation.
▪While the %GPM from rental slightly decreased YoY and QoQ, mainly from 
marginal drop in the average occupancy rate and additional expenses 
related to the opening of the new LW Ramkhamhaeng branch which also 
required time for tenants to complete their shop decoration.9M/2025
▪Operating revenue slightly increased compared to the previous year.
▪Despite the economic slowdown, the Company managed to achieve 
sales growth, driven primarily by the continued expansion of online 
sales and the solid performance of overseas OEM business.
▪The %GPM also improved mainly from the effective discount 
management and a lower proportion of project sales.
▪Rental and services revenue increased +5.2% YoY from the new 
branches opened during the year and the expanded rental space 
after Chiang Mai branch renovation.
▪The rental %GPM slightly declined due to a lower average 
occupancy rate, partly resulting from newly opened branches 
toward the end of the quarter, which some tenants had not yet fully 
occupied their spaces, including additional expenses related to the 
opening phase.
(THB million)

Selling & Administrative Expenses
The 3Q/2025 SG&A expenses increased +5.9% YoY and +8.1% QoQ, while 9M/2025 SG&A 
expenses increased +4.1% YoY mainly due to:
➢The expansion of new ILM & LW branches, including the new business (Flying Tiger 
Copenhagen). 
➢The increase of promotional and delivery expenses along with the higher sales.
➢The platform fees increased from higher online sales and from gradually adjusted by 
marketplace platforms.
➢The expenses for IT systems development.Quarterly Period 9-Month Period
